The President appoints CIC members on the recommendation of a committee consisting of:
• Prime Minister – Chairperson
• Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha
• Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister

items: Crucial distinction: The President appoints CIC members, but only upon the recommendation of the selection committee.
Note the house specification: It is the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha (not Rajya Sabha).
The Union Cabinet Minister member is specifically nominated by the Prime Minister.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The President formally appoints members of the Central Information Commission (CIC).
Appointments are strictly made based on recommendations from a specialized three-member committee.
The Prime Minister acts as the Chairperson of the Appointment Committee.
The Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha is a statutory member of the committee.
A Union Cabinet Minister, nominated directly by the Prime Minister, completes the committee.
